title: Define Minimal Memory Tensor RT Simulation Protocol
purpose: Specify the first executable simulation protocol for Memory Tensor RT using tensor-domain displacement traces, prompt conditioning, recall output, and confidence emergence.
simulation_steps: initialize tensor array with displacement_trace cells
receive prompt and derive implied memory m
derive coupling condition kappa from prompt and context
derive orientation O from kappa and m
select tensor slice S using O
emit memory output M and confidence C
record trajectory trace and resolution stability

required_experiments.name: Prompt Conditioning Shift
required_experiments.test: Same TA, different implied memory m should alter orientation O and may alter M or C.

required_experiments.name: Tensor History Difference
required_experiments.test: Different TA histories under same prompt should produce different trajectories or confidence patterns.

required_experiments.name: High Confidence False Resolution
required_experiments.test: High C may occur when M differs from external ground truth if rho is locally stable.

required_experiments.name: Repeated Coupling Perturbation
required_experiments.test: Repeated prompts should update history_weight and alter future traversal probabilities.

forbidden_shortcuts: Do not implement recall as direct lookup.
Do not assign confidence independently of resolution stability.
Do not omit coupling before orientation.
Do not treat tensor displacement as detached from action_trace_id.
